`sample.mp4` is the H.264/AAC media fixture from
[abema/go-mp4 v1.7.3](https://github.com/abema/go-mp4/tree/v1.7.3/testdata).
It is included unchanged under the accompanying MIT license.
Tests may append a valid `free` box to exercise multiple upload chunks.
This fixture proves metadata inspection and byte preservation, not live X acceptance.
